SELECT * FROM ( SELECT
A.REC_ID as recId, A.ACCOUNT as account, A.YEAR as year, A.EDITION as edition,
A.COST_CENTER || '-' || COALESCE(B.COST_CENTER_DSCR,'') as costCenter,
A.PRODUCT_CODE_4 as productCode4,
substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,1,5) as productCode, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,6,8) || '-' || COALESCE(C.ST_NO_DESC,'') as stNo, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,14,7) as thickChr, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,21,8) as widthChr, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,29,6) as coatingType, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,35,6) as ctrlRollCode, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,41,6) as heatProcLog, substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,47) as sgSign,
A.WCE || '-' || COALESCE(D.WCE_DESCRIPTION,'') as wce,
A.PLUNGE_WEIGHT_1 as plungeWeight1, A.PLUNGE_WEIGHT_2 as plungeWeight2, A.LAST_YEAR_PLUNGE as lastYearPlunge, A.STD_PLUNGE as stdPlunge, A.PLUNGE_PRDT_CODE as plungePrdtCode,
A.MODIFY_NAME as modifyName, A.MODIFY_DATE as modifyDate, A.KEY as key,
A.YEAR || VARCHAR(A.EDITION) as yEdition
FROM EGJHSU.SA_JH00_WA0001 A
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT COST_CENTER, MAX(COST_CENTER_DSCR) COST_CENTER_DSCR FROM EGGMM1.TACACT6 GROUP BY COST_CENTER ) B ON A.COST_CENTER = B.COST_CENTER
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ST_NO, MAX(ST_NO_DESC) ST_NO_DESC FROM EGGMM1.TQMTS0X GROUP BY ST_NO ) C ON SUBSTR(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,6,8) = C.ST_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT WCE, MAX(WCE_DESCRIPTION) WCE_DESCRIPTION FROM EGGMM1.TACACT7 GROUP BY WCE ) D ON A.WCE = D.WCE
WHERE 1=1
(A.YEAR || A.EDITION) = #version#
A.COST_CENTER = #costCenter#
substr(A.PRODUCT_CODE_4,6,8) = #steelMark#
A.WCE = #wce#
) T
$orderBy$
